attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Tamsin knelt in the red-stained dirt of the Lancers' camp","severity":"major","reason":"places Tamsin at the Lancers' camp where Joska died; the briefing does not put her there"},{"span":"her father’s heavy, notched blade","severity":"minor","reason":"adds a weapon the briefing never mentions; Joska is a pit fighter, so a blade is not obviously his"},{"span":"the jagged scar from Rook Malley’s initial strike","severity":"minor","reason":"briefing says only 'maimed'; the scar and the strike are added detail about the past"},{"span":"his mangled arm","severity":"minor","reason":"briefing gives no wound location; maiming is specified as an arm only by invention"},{"span":"the pirate captain’s banner fluttering nearby","severity":"minor","reason":"banner is not in the briefing; it is presented as present-moment staging but names a new object"}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"Placing Tamsin at the Lancers' camp, kneeling over the body, goes beyond what the briefing supports, and it adds a weapon and wound details. The ending does state a clear intent, but the prose leans on generic action-story phrasing (\"knuckles turned white\", \"growl vibrated in her chest\")."}
